title: Distinguish knowing an optimal value from implementing recovery
statement: All even compressed H_W moments equal I and odd ones zero, independent of W. Yet the physical leakage images depend on W. Averaging W over Weyl unitaries makes the leakage branch depolarizing, proving exact moment-only minimax loss p(1-1/d^2), while the informed flag-controlled inverse has zero loss.
